column1: # Old addresses of this site that no page answers any more, each with the page that replaced it · created 2026-11-15
# The old site was reorganised several times before the 2026-10 rebuild, and search engines still list addresses from every one of those layouts.
# Built from the repository's own history: every page path any commit ever held under docs/, kept here when its address answered 404 on the live site.
# The build writes a redirect stub for each row (astro.config.mjs reads this file); the stub is noindex and names the new page as canonical.
# old = the address without .html and without a trailing slash (Pages serves the stub as both /x and /x.html). new = a current page, never another stub.
# npm run verify holds every row: the stub is in the build, it points where the row says, and the target is a real page (its anchor too).
